heading: Join the lab
lede: We welcome enquiries from people who want to work on robot learning and control. There is no application form: write to us.

audiences.title: Prospective PhD students
audiences.text: If your interests sit in one of our research fields, tell us which one and what you would like to find out. PhD admission is through the university's graduate programs; write to us before you apply.

audiences.title: Postdoctoral researchers
audiences.text: If you hold, or are completing, a doctorate in robotics, control or machine learning, tell us what you would bring and what you would build here.

audiences.title: Undergraduate researchers
audiences.text: If you study at NYU Abu Dhabi and want research experience in robot learning and control, tell us what draws you to it.

include_heading: What to include in your email
include: A subject line that starts with “REACH Lab enquiry” and names the kind of position you have in mind.
A few sentences on the research field that interests you most, and why.
One piece of your own work — a thesis, paper, report, project or code repository — with a link.
closing: Before you write, read a few of our recent publications: the best enquiries show that you have.
